actions.reason: K8_C0001 has an interpretable RNA identity (coordinated down-regulation of oxidative-phosphorylation, estrogen-response, adipogenesis, protein-secretion, and fatty-acid-metabolism programs), but the evidence that directly bears on its current membership does not support independent retention: set-level alignment shows near-zero or negative silhouettes and within-set distances not consistently below between-set distances across CT, RNA, WSI, and WXS, providing limited geometric support for treating it as a separately represented unit. No decision-changing request remains available for this candidate, so independent retention is not positively justified.

K8_C0002 has a coherent biological identity (immune/inflammatory and interferon programs down with oxidative-phosphorylation and lipid/energy-metabolism programs up; VHL-depleted, TP53-enriched mutation profile) and, unlike the weakly represented candidates, its current membership is positively supported: set-level alignment shows positive silhouettes in all four modalities (0.02-0.18) with within-set mean distances uniformly below between-set distances, indicating the membership is distinguished from the rest in native geometry. The K8_C0002-K8_C0003 boundary was already assessed at pair scope (weak but consistently positive native-geometry boundary; near-zero fused-geometry boundary silhouette with a single-cluster-dominated union), and no further pair request remains available; that weak boundary does not by itself justify a merge, so continued independent treatment is warranted.

K8_C0003 has an interpretable RNA identity (up-regulated TNFA-NFKB, interferon-alpha, allograft-rejection, and stress-response programs), but the evidence bearing on its current membership does not support independent retention: set-level alignment shows near-zero or negative silhouettes in CT, RNA, and WSI with within-set distances not consistently below between-set distances, and its mutation phenotype is largely unremarkable within the ccRCC driver panel (no driver-panel gene survives driver-panel-level control; only the non-panel gene FLG survives global control). The K8_C0002-K8_C0003 boundary was already assessed at pair scope and no further pair request remains available; the weak boundary does not justify a merge, and independent retention is not positively justified.

K8_C0004 has an interpretable RNA identity (down-regulation of immune/inflammatory and interferon programs with down-regulation of EMT and proliferative pathways), but the evidence directly bearing on its current membership does not support independent retention: set-level alignment shows negative silhouettes in CT and WSI, near-zero in RNA, and within-set distances not consistently below between-set distances across modalities, providing limited geometric support for treating it as a separately represented unit. No decision-changing request remains available, so independent retention is not positively justified.

K8_C0005 has a coherent biological identity (up-regulated interferon, allograft-rejection, IL6-JAK-STAT3, inflammatory, and complement programs; striking BAP1 enrichment surviving both driver-panel and global control) and its current membership is positively supported: set-level alignment shows modestly positive silhouettes in RNA, WSI, and WXS with within-set mean distances below between-set distances in those three modalities, indicating the membership is distinguished from the rest in native geometry. The distinction is absent in CT, but the preponderance of modality-specific membership evidence supports continued independent treatment.

K8_C0006 has an interpretable RNA identity (down-regulation of oxidative-phosphorylation, EMT, glycolysis, ROS, and MTORC1 programs with up-regulation of WNT, mitotic-spindle, Hedgehog, and angiogenesis pathways), but the evidence directly bearing on its current membership does not support independent retention: set-level alignment shows a distinction confined to CT (positive silhouette) with near-zero or negative silhouettes and within-set distances at or above between-set distances in RNA, WSI, and WXS, providing only limited and modality-dependent geometric support. No decision-changing request remains available, so independent retention is not positively justified.

K8_C0007 has an interpretable RNA identity (up-regulated mesenchymal/stromal programs with down-regulation of oxidative-phosphorylation, MYC-target, ROS, and DNA-repair programs), but the evidence directly bearing on its current membership does not support independent retention: set-level alignment shows negative silhouettes in CT, near-zero in RNA and WSI, and within-set distances not consistently below between-set distances across modalities, providing limited geometric support for treating it as a separately represented unit. No decision-changing request remains available, so independent retention is not positively justified.

K8_C0008 has an interpretable RNA identity (up-regulated proliferative G2M/E2F/MTORC1/MYC programs with down-regulation of immune/inflammatory and interferon programs), but the evidence directly bearing on its current membership does not support independent retention: set-level alignment shows a distinction confined to WSI and WXS with negative silhouettes in CT and RNA and within-set distances above between-set distances in those modalities, providing only limited and modality-dependent geometric support. No decision-changing request remains available, so independent retention is not positively justified.
